missions.title: A hive of your own
missions.button: Dawud will sell you a hive · 30 coins

a.text: Dawud shows you a clay hive at the end of his row. “I'll keep the bees for you and sell the honey. Your share every week.”
Dawud counts out six coins. “Good week. The bees liked the thyme.”
